verdict.rationale: A marketplace of ready-made scrapers is a fair question for a web-scraping platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Firecrawl offering a marketplace or catalog of prebuilt, community- or vendor-published scrapers. Its generic scrape, crawl, agent and extract endpoints, and the CLI that adds 'skills' to coding agents, are different features, not runnable marketplace scrapers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch
